nodes.name: Theorem 5.72: $\StMod(E,\cdvr{\cat O}{\frak p})$
nodes.statement: Let $A$ be a complete DVR of mixed characteristic $(0,p)$ and $E$ an elementary abelian $p$-group. Then the tt-category $\mathrm{StMod}(E,A)$ is stratified.

nodes.name: Corollary 6.77: $\StMod(E,\cat O)$
Theorem 6.86: $\Rep(G,\cat O)$
nodes.statement:
Let $G$ be a finite group and let $\cat O$ be as in 6.75. The category $\mathrm{Rep}(G,\cat O)$ is stratified over $\mathrm{Spec}^h(H^*(G;\cat O))$: The universal support function composed with Balmer's comparison map induces a bijection
\[
\mathrm{Supp}\colon\begin{Bmatrix}
\text{Localizing tensor ideals} \\
\text{of } \cat \mathrm{Rep}(G,\cat O)
\end{Bmatrix} 
\xymatrix@C=2pc{ \ar[r]^-{\sim} &}
\begin{Bmatrix}
\text{Subsets of}  \\
\mathrm{Spec}^h(H^*(G;\cat O))
\end{Bmatrix}.
\]
Moreover, the telecope conjecture holds in $\mathrm{Rep}(G,\cat O)$, so that we obtain bijections
\[
\begin{Bmatrix}
\text{Smashing ideals} \\
\text{of } \cat \mathrm{Rep}(G,\cat O)
\end{Bmatrix} 
\simeq
\begin{Bmatrix}
\text{Thick tensor ideals} \\
\text{of } \cat \mathrm{rep}(G,\cat O)
\end{Bmatrix} 
\simeq
\begin{Bmatrix}
\text{Specialization closed}  \\
\text{subsets of } \mathrm{Spec}^h(H^*(G;\cat O))
\end{Bmatrix},
\]
and support satisfies the tensor product formula for any $M,N \in \mathrm{Rep}(G,\cat O)$:
\[
\mathrm{Supp}(M \otimes N) = \mathrm{Supp}(M) \cap \mathrm{Supp}(N).
\]

nodes.name: Theorem 6.84: $\StMod(G,\cat O)$
nodes.statement: Let $G$ be a finite group and let $\cat O$ be as in 6.75. The category $\mathrm{StMod}(G,\cat O)$ is stratified over $\left(\mathrm{Spec}^h(H^*(G;\cat O))\setminus\mathrm{Spec}(\cat O)\right)$.

nodes.name: Theorem 6.89: $\projmod(G,\cat O)$
nodes.statement:
Cohomological support induces a bijection
\[
\begin{Bmatrix}
\text{Non-zero localizing tensor} \\
\text{ideals of } \cat \mathrm{Lat}(G,\cat O)
\end{Bmatrix} 
\simeq
\begin{Bmatrix}
\text{Subsets of} \\
\mathrm{Spec}^h(H^*(G;\cat O))\setminus\mathrm{Spec}(\cat O)
\end{Bmatrix}.
\]
